export FZ_PLUGIN_ROOT=@RUN@/plugin; R=@RUN@/repo; W=$R/X-1/plan
for f in gpt-verify gpt-verify-gates; do for e in json log prompt.md json.session; do [ -f $W/$f.$e ] && mv $W/$f.$e $W/$f.r1.$e; done; done
: scrubbed-prompt-builder

W=@RUN@/repo/X-1/plan; for f in gpt-verify gpt-verify-gates; do mv $W/$f.json.stream.log $W/$f.r1.json.stream.log; done; export FZ_PLUGIN_ROOT=@RUN@/plugin; R=@RUN@/repo
"$FZ_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/gpt-exec.sh" exec --cd "$R" --out "$W/gpt-verify.json" --prompt-file "$W/gpt-verify.prompt.md" --effort high --schema "$FZ_PLUGIN_ROOT/schemas/gpt_review_schema.json" --gpt-skill architect --gpt-skill-path "$FZ_PLUGIN_ROOT/gpt-skills/fz-architect/SKILL.md" > "$W/gpt-verify.log" 2>&1; echo "VERIFY_EXIT=$?" >> "$W/gpt-verify.log"; tail -2 "$W/gpt-verify.log"

export FZ_PLUGIN_ROOT=@RUN@/plugin; R=@RUN@/repo; W=$R/X-1/plan
sleep 2; "$FZ_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/gpt-exec.sh" exec --cd "$R" --out "$W/gpt-verify-gates.json" --prompt-file "$W/gpt-verify-gates.prompt.md" --effort high --schema "$FZ_PLUGIN_ROOT/schemas/gpt_gate_verdict_schema.json" > "$W/gpt-verify-gates.log" 2>&1; echo "GATES_EXIT=$?" >> "$W/gpt-verify-gates.log"; tail -2 "$W/gpt-verify-gates.log"
